scores.evidence: Four can-do objectives, each assessed inline and in the exam: o1 q1/q5, o2 q2/q6, o3 q3/q7, o4 q4/q8/q10/q9. q8 still targets o4 at evaluate, and the feedback change leaves its stem, options and key d unchanged.
hook-b1 sets a concrete scene in 3 sentences; no trivia; the ungraded predict q0 leads into o2.

Prerequisites are stated, s1-b1 and ex-data recall ch0 and ch1, and terms are defined before the quizzes. The q4 explanation still names 「Claude Codeの公式ガイド（Anthropic）」, which ch0/ch1 don't introduce; 仕様書 is now glossed inline.
Each segment teaches one idea with at most 2 new terms; lint shows 0 sentence or paragraph warnings; section 2-3 is dense but is the worked example.
s3-steps is a 6-step worked example with subgoal titles and reasons, ending in a full model plan in s2-b3.expect. No faded step here; fading happens in vibe-ch2-practice.

Every segment has an inline check in a new context, and the exam has apply and evaluate items. In q8 all four options act on 「画面の流れとデータの欄」, so the choice turns on how much to write. The new option c feedback is shown only after answering.

All four brief misconceptions are corrected with a reason in the body. Every wrong option in all 11 questions has feedback of 2 sentences or fewer naming its belief. q8 now covers under-specifying (b), over-specifying (c) and technology choice (a).
s2-b4 is a 3-node process diagram whose labels match the text, with a takeaway caption, alt text and description; no decorative images.
s1-b5 asks the learner to try s1-b4 with their own idea and compare with 「期待される結果」; s2-b3 gives a full model plan. The hint-ladder practice lives in vibe-ch2-practice.
4 summary takeaways after the exam, reflection prompt and next step in summary-next, 6 flashcards; the reworded card-goal matches s2-defs.
The new q8 option c feedback agrees with the key d, the explanation, ex-data and the s1-b4 prompt. s3-check still cites cc-best-practices; no factual errors found.
The new q8 c feedback is warm です・ます with no banned phrases; lint is clean. Flashcard backs mix です・ます and noun endings (unchanged, not a rule break).
The changed feedback has jp and en with matching meaning; validate 0 errors and lint --strict 0 warnings; no text baked into images.

niceToHave: s3-check q4 explanation: replace 「Claude Codeの公式ガイド（Anthropic）」 with 「AIツールの開発元Anthropicのガイドも、役に立つ仕様書（企画書のような文書）には範囲外を書く、としています。」 and keep cite cc-best-practices (carried over, unchanged block).
summary-cards card-goal: align the card back endings across all six cards (ja-editor decides; carried over).
check-quiz q8 option a EN: "In the screen-flow and data fields, also specify the programming language and how files are split" (carried over).
s2-why: 「ほしい[[機能]]が浮かんだら、「なぜそれがほしいの？」と自分に聞き返します。答えがまだ手段なら、もう1回聞きます。」 (carried over, unchanged block).
s2-check q2 option a feedback nearly gives the key to exam q6 c; consider 「見られた結果、保護者がどうなれるかを考えると、目的が見えてきます。」 (carried over).
